summary: Tested RDS features including RDS Settings page, all RDS API endpoints, WordPress audio format, and rundown text display. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in rds_scheduler.py. All 13 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend RDS Settings page works correctly with all sections (Configuration, API Endpoints, Cache Logs) functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed MongoDB ObjectId bug in /app/backend/services/rds_scheduler.py - added log_entry.pop('_id', None) after inserting to database
WordPress publish correctly includes 'format': 'audio' at line 454 in wordpress.py
SortableRundownItem.js correctly removed line-clamp-2 (verified via grep - no line-clamp classes present)
RDS scheduler correctly configured for 5-minute interval (check_interval = 300)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing Social Club show which is currently live
context_for_next_testing_agent: RDS features implemented and working. RDS Settings page accessible at /rds. Public endpoints (/api/rds/live, /api/rds/cached-rundown) work without auth. Authenticated endpoints (/api/rds/settings, /api/rds/endpoints, /api/rds/logs) require admin auth. Cache refresh button and 5-minute scheduler working correctly.

GET /api/rds/live.details: Returns plain text of live show title (currently 'Social Club')

GET /api/rds/cached-rundown.details: Public endpoint returns cached show data with items array

GET /api/rds/endpoints.details: Returns list of 4 API endpoints with URLs and descriptions

GET /api/rds/logs.details: Returns cache refresh logs with status (success/failed/no_show)

POST /api/rds/refresh-cache.details: Manually triggers cache refresh, returns success message

WordPress format: audio.details: Verified at line 454 in wordpress.py - 'format': 'audio' included in wp_data

Rundown text no truncation.details: Verified SortableRundownItem.js has no line-clamp classes

RDS Settings Frontend Page.details: Page at /rds shows Configuration, API Endpoints, Cache Logs sections

bug_fixed.root_cause: log_entry dictionary was appended to results after insert_one(), which adds _id field with ObjectId
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added log_entry.pop('_id', None) after each insert_one() call in rds_scheduler.py
bug_fixed.verification: POST /api/rds/refresh-cache now returns 200 with valid JSON response
